scripts.ci:contracts: cd contracts && ([ -d lib/forge-std/src ] || forge install foundry-rs/forge-std@v1.9.6 --no-git) && forge build
scripts.ci:local: pnpm check && pnpm ci:contracts && pnpm --filter web-app build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter contracts test && pnpm --filter sso-interop-backend test && pnpm --filter prividium-setup test && pnpm --filter web-app test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm --filter prividium-setup test:anvil-smoke
scripts.test:integration:local: RUN_LIVE_PRIVIDIUM_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter sso-interop-backend test:integration && RUN_LIVE_PRIVIDIUM_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter prividium-setup test:integration && RUN_LIVE_PRIVIDIUM_TESTS=1 pnpm --filter web-app test:integration
scripts.setup-env: cp web-app/.env.example web-app/.env && cp contracts/.env.example contracts/.env && cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
